sloka: सन्दिष्टौ मुनिना तेन तावुभौ मैथिलीसुतौ ।तथैव करवावेति निर्जग्मतुररिन्दमौ ।। ७.९३.१८ ॥
transliteration: sandiṣṭau muninā tena tāvubhau maithilīsutau ।tathaiva karavāveti nirjagmaturarindamau ।। 7.93.18 ॥

translations.english: Having been instructed by that sage, both sons of Maithili, those subduers of enemies, departed, saying, "We shall do just so."
